items.name: The instrument maintainer moves a golden for a recorded reason
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: After write g-40/s-12, move to g-41 for instrument-behavior-changed with the note and s-12 returned instrument-golden-moved {from g-40, to g-41, reason, note, scenario-digest s-12}; instrument-goldens shows digest g-41, scenario-digest s-12, moves [{g-40->g-41, instrument-behavior-changed, note}]; persists across restart on the same store.

items.name: "Spec grew" over a diff that is not additions only is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: G-checklist at g-50; move to g-51 for spec-grew with additions-only false -> -32000 spec-grew-not-additions-only; goldens still g-50, no moves. Control: same move with additions-only true succeeds. Ordering held (requires 3 before empty-note 4).

items.name: A move without a note is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Move g-40->g-41 instrument-behavior-changed with note "" -> -32000 empty-note (not -32602); goldens still g-40, no moves.

items.name: A golden is never moved for a reason outside the three
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: reason "make the self-check green" (and hyphenated form) -> -32602 naming reason's enum of the three; goldens still g-40, no moves.

items.name: A golden whose scenario digest is not its scenario's is refused
items.rule: An instrument golden is written from its scenario and carries that scenario's digest
items.evidence: Digests file {scenario: s-12}; write G-score-unknown with s-11 -> -32000 scenario-digest-mismatch; instrument-goldens []. Also refused for an unnamed scenario and with no digests file.

items.name: A move to the same digest is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Move g-40->g-40 wording-replaced 'no change' -> -32000 same-digest; golden moves []. same-digest wins over later requires when several fail.

items.name: A move that names a stale scenario digest is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Written g-40/s-12, then digests file rewritten to s-13 (no restart); move wording-replaced 'reworded' with s-12 -> -32000 stale-scenario-digest; golden still g-40 / s-12, no moves. Control: same move with s-13 succeeds and golden scenario-digest becomes s-13.

items.name: The instrument maintainer writes a golden from its scenario
items.rule: An instrument golden is written from its scenario and carries that scenario's digest
items.evidence: Write G-score-unknown s-12/g-40 -> instrument-golden-written {golden-id, scenario, scenario-digest s-12, path, digest g-40, written-at}; instrument-goldens shows G-score-unknown g-40 / s-12, moves []. Duplicate write refused golden-exists.
